description: This plugin runs inside Indigo's embedded Python (3.13 in Indigo 2025.2 and 2026.1), not an interpreter we choose. Strict constraint filtering makes Renovate offer only PyPI releases whose Requires-Python accepts 3.13. The constraint must be a single version, not a range: Renovate's pep440 versioning cannot compare two ranges (it has no subset check), so the former "==3.13.*" rejected every release that declares Requires-Python, i.e. every current release, and Renovate offered nothing. Raise it by hand when Perceptive Automation ships a new Python with Indigo.

packageRules.description: Keep the Python constraint above fixed. Renovate tracks `constraints.python` as a tool-constraint dependency and would otherwise propose moving it to the newest Python, which defeats its purpose. Raise it by hand when Indigo ships a new Python.
If a CI workflow is added, it must test the interpreter Indigo uses (3.13), not the newest Python. Bump it by hand together with the constraint above.
